newsitem.title: USA: Cooper buys power distribution manufacturer.
newsitem.headline: Cooper buys power distribution manufacturer.

text.p: Cooper Industries Inc said Monday it bought Kearney Co Inc, a manufacturer of power distribution equipment in Tucker, Ga., for an undisclosed sum.
A spokeswoman declined to elaborate on the terms of the deal.
The manufacturer of electrical products said Kearney, which is a subsidiary of the private Dyson-Kissner-Moran Corp of New York, posted $53 million in revenues in 1996 and employs 300 people.
Cooper posted net profits of $77.7 million, or $0.67 a share, in the first quarter, compared with $62.1 million, or $0.56 a share the year before.
It said May 30 it expected to realize a $45 million after-tax gain in the second quarter from the sale of Kirsch drapery hardware and custom window business to Newell Co in May.
